hero.title: Your apartment, booked. Your phone, quiet.
hero.sub: I take over your Airbnb listing in Cairo or Ain Sokhna and run it: the listing, the prices, the guests, the reviews and the payouts. I spent four years inside Airbnb, so I know how the platform actually works.
hero.ribbon_caption: 365 nights a year. I watch every one of them.

owners.title: What I do for owners
owners.lead: You hand me the listing. I handle everything that happens on Airbnb.

items.d: Title, description, photo order and amenities, written in English, French and Arabic so travellers from everywhere understand it.
Nightly prices that move with weekends, Eid, Christmas and the beach season, inside the minimum you set.
Fast replies before, during and after every stay. House rules explained before arrival, not after a problem.
When something goes wrong, I know the Airbnb process from the inside: reviews, disputes and AirCover claims.
A plain statement of every booking and your share, settled on a fixed schedule.

owners.you_lead: I manage the listing, not the building. Clear lines mean no surprises for anyone.

why.title: Why me

steps.d: Hotel operations, airline reservation systems, Lufthansa Cargo and Trip.com.
France Specialist and Trainer, Ambassador and AirCover Specialist.
Independent co-host across Cairo, Ain Sokhna and Siwa. Superhost on my own account.

why.langs: I answer guests in Arabic, English and French.

areas.title: Where I work
areas.cairo_d: Zamalek, Sheikh Zayed and more. City flats for travellers, families and long stays.
areas.sokhna_d: Palm Beach villas with pools, an hour and a half from Cairo. Busy every weekend and every Eid.

guests.title: For guests
guests.lead: Staying in one of my places, or anywhere in Cairo? Two things I can sort for you.
guests.tour_d: The Pyramids, Old Cairo, Khan el Khalili, or a day you design. I lead the day: the plan, the timing and the transport.
guests.pickup_d: A private pickup from Cairo airport in an electric car. Quiet, cool, and already waiting when you land.

items.a: Your own team. I handle the listing, prices, guests, reviews and payouts. We agree the handover details before the first booking.

items.q: Do I lose control of my place?
items.a: No. You set the lowest price you accept, and you can block any dates you want for yourself.
Cairo (Zamalek, Sheikh Zayed and more) and Ain Sokhna. Somewhere else? Ask anyway.
A percentage of each booking. The rate depends on the property, so let's talk about yours on WhatsApp.

contact.title: Let's talk about your place
contact.lead: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach me. Send a few photos and the area, and I'll tell you honestly what it can do on Airbnb.
